title: Kavosh project manifest
description: Machine-readable project profile. Read by KavoshStart workflows and agents. Stable facts only — no status.

kavoshStart.description: Exact KavoshStart release tag (vX.Y.Z) for consumer repositories. Reserved value 'self' is valid only for the canonical bagdeli/KavoshStart repository, which executes its checked-out source directly.

visibility.description: Actual repository visibility. Private repositories may use an available isolated, repository-scoped GitHub Actions self-hosted runner under CI-2. Standard GitHub-hosted Actions in private are prohibited unless the designated human billing owner (the user, not another administrator or agent) explicitly approves each exact proposed run before manual dispatch, even within included free minutes. Public standard GitHub-hosted is allowed under current public-repository terms; isolated public self-hosted requires CI-2. An independent CI worker outside GitHub Actions is a separate execution mechanism. Other metered/billable GitHub services in private repositories require this person's specific prior approval (ADR-0019).

tierOverride.description: ADR path if tier differs from CLASSIFICATION.md result

projectKind.description: library = consumed by other Kavosh repositories (classifies at least T1)

adoptionPhase.description: Deprecated legacy migration marker. Consumers of the current standard must not set this to true; it never authorizes enforce:false.

exceptionADR.description: Approved custom UI without a pinned design-system package; includes RTL, accessibility, ownership, scope and tests.

package.description: Design-system package selected by the consuming project. Never publish private provider identifiers in the public standard.

version.description: Exact package release version; no floating ranges.

designSystem.description: Consumer-owned provider and exact pin; null requires an approved exception for UI projects.

authorizationADR.description: Required for method=custom; proves equivalent release/security gates.

migrationMode.description: Defaults to expand-contract. maintenance-window is limited to T1 with a migration ADR and per-run owner authorization.

runner.description: Private GitHub Actions: self-hosted on an authorized isolated server may run automatically when available; standard GitHub-hosted is prohibited without one prior explicit authorization by the designated human billing owner for the exact workflow/ref/PR/head SHA and manual dispatch. Public: standard GitHub-hosted is free for standard minutes; self-hosted requires isolation and untrusted-code controls. T1/static may use none without Actions.

runnerLabels.description: Exact registered labels of a real isolated GitHub Actions self-hosted runner; default [self-hosted, linux, x64, repo-slug]. Explicit Linux/Windows/macOS, x64/ARM/ARM64 and custom selector labels are allowed even if the dedicated custom label differs from the repository slug. Require a non-generic custom selector documented in the consumer-owned accepted CI-2 trust ADR, exact manifest/workflow/reusable-caller match and independent physical registration/scope/isolation proof. Static strings cannot certify a physical runner. Reject dynamic expressions and unverified shared runner groups. Workflow matching is case-insensitive and set-based, with no missing/extra/duplicate values; list the self-hosted label first. Default for all workflow jobs unless one exact job declares an optional ci.runnerJobLabels override.

runners.description: Self-hosted capacity hint; does not provision a runner or certify its isolation. Size by queue/SLO.

monthlyMinutesBudget.description: Portfolio/account planning hint only. It is not a core engineering gate and never grants billable execution. In private it never substitutes for the designated human billing owner's prior metered-use authorization (ADR-0019).

trustModelADR.description: Self-hosted (private or public) trust ADR: available runner, containment/isolation, untrusted-code and credential boundaries. Required by CI-2 governance; not a special per-run billing approval. Keep untrusted code separate from privileged CI, release, deploy and credentials; literal labels cannot prove real isolation. Proposed/pending ADRs cannot prove an accepted self-hosted trust boundary. A bounded, owner-accepted risk profile on an existing independent host may combine unprivileged service users, local file/socket isolation and firewall controls; disposable VMs are optional, firewall-only is not host isolation.

requiredWorkflow.description: Optional path of the workflow that exposes the stable `required` aggregate job. Defaults to .github/workflows/ci.yml (or self-check.yml for KavoshStart itself).

runnerJobLabels.description: Optional per-job explicit self-hosted labels. Keys use '.github/workflows/<file>.yml#<job-id>'; each value is a complete static self-hosted selector for that exact job only. Unlisted jobs retain ci.runnerLabels. Does not provision runners, authorize privileged jobs, or permit private hosted minutes.

prMaxLines.description: Deprecated compatibility field. KavoshStart v2 does not use line/file counts as a merge gate; remove on normal upgrade.

independentHumanReview.description: Optional explicit owner-selected second-person GitHub UI reviewer, only for a sizeable team (at least two real contributors and four domains). Missing/false means the sole owner reviews directly and no second-person visual gate is created.

review.description: Optional team review, not inferred from tier, runtime or risk. Never creates a human or paid reviewer automatically.

mode.description: Optional owner-selected release-scope continuous acceptance. Mode none is allowed at any tier, including T2 solo-owner projects. Choosing continuous activates separate review/evidence obligations: disclose actual producer/App costs before selection.

assurance.description: For explicitly selected continuous acceptance only: choose risk-based or attested at intake; the independent App/decision protocol is needed for specialist/high-risk items. Do not choose this for a solo-owner project merely because of tier.

acceptance.description: Acceptance is optional even for T2; absent or mode none needs no independent publisher. Explicit continuous requires an intentional assurance selection and real producers when its high/specialist contract applies. Old pinned consumers remain unchanged.

strategy.description: Release implementation strategy. This is an adapter choice, not the release safety contract; all strategies must preserve REL-1/2/5/6.

strategyADR.description: Required for changesets/custom strategies; proves equivalent SemVer, vX.Y.Z immutable tag, exact-source provenance and release gating.

workflow.description: Release workflow adapter. Defaults to .github/workflows/release.yml for release-please; required for non-default release strategies.

command.description: Repository-owned shell command that prepares and builds release assets. Required for release-please artifact packaging when automation.interface is not make; Make consumers may use the default make setup + make package adapter.

items.description: Relative glob under the repository checkout. Absolute paths and parent traversal are forbidden.

paths.description: One or more relative globs whose regular files are attached to the GitHub Release.

artifact.description: Optional default-release artifact adapter. Non-default release strategies own their artifact process in their declared workflow/ADR.

testStaging.description: Opt-in owner-dispatched Test staging contract. Presence activates exact-manifest actor, receipt and CI guards; it does not complete ACC-3 or authorize Production.

interface.description: Adapter exposing semantic setup/lint/test/build/check operations. The underlying language/tool is not a KavoshStart invariant.

capabilities.description: Composable project capabilities. Tier controls assurance/process; runtime controls execution shape; capabilities control domain-specific applicability/evidence. Technology names are not capabilities.

then.description: Private GitHub-hosted or no-Actions modes cannot declare self-hosted runner metadata; GitHub-hosted requires explicit designated human billing owner's consent before each exact run.

ci.description: Private self-hosted is allowed with CI-2 trust verification; hosted remains consent-gated.
